# Breadcrumb

Composes a navigation trail from links, separators and a non-interactive current-page label. Use the exported parts to reflect the page hierarchy; it does not infer routes or generate the trail.

- **Import:** `import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbEllipsis, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/navigation-breadcrumb--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  Breadcrumb,
  BreadcrumbItem,
  BreadcrumbLink,
  BreadcrumbList,
  BreadcrumbPage,
  BreadcrumbSeparator,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function BreadcrumbExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Breadcrumb>
        <BreadcrumbList>
          <BreadcrumbItem>
            <BreadcrumbLink href="/">Home</BreadcrumbLink>
          </BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbSeparator />
          <BreadcrumbItem>
            <BreadcrumbLink href="/components">Components</BreadcrumbLink>
          </BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbSeparator />
          <BreadcrumbItem>
            <BreadcrumbPage>Breadcrumb</BreadcrumbPage>
          </BreadcrumbItem>
        </BreadcrumbList>
      </Breadcrumb>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Breadcrumb

It forwards its ref to `HTMLElement`. Its props are `Omit<React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, HTMLElement>, "ref"> & { separator?: React.ReactNode }`.

- `separator`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## BreadcrumbList

It forwards its ref to `HTMLOListElement`. Its props are `Omit<React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.OlHTMLAttributes<HTMLOListElement>, HTMLOListElement>, "ref">`.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## BreadcrumbItem

It forwards its ref to `HTMLLIElement`. Its props are `Omit<React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.LiHTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>, HTMLLIElement>, "ref">`.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## BreadcrumbLink

It forwards its ref to `HTMLAnchorElement`. Its props are `Omit<React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>, HTMLAnchorElement>, "ref"> & { asChild?: boolean }`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

It forwards its ref to `HTMLSpanElement`. Its props are `Omit<React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, HTMLSpanElement>, "ref">`.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
